name: El Dorado State Park (Shady Creek)
note: Shady Creek area of El Dorado State Park (KDWP), on the south shore of El Dorado Lake off NE Shady Creek Access Road: primitive gravel sites in Sunset Cove, Veterans Point and Patriot Lane, plus 19 walk-in tent sites in Shady Creek Outback. The booking site files every site as a tent site, but the gravel pads list 30-ft vehicles and 29 are pull-throughs, and the imagery shows an RV parked on a Veterans Point pad (2026-11-06). Bluestem Point, across the cove, is its own entry. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: campitks.gov (2026-11-06): the 'Shady Creek' loop filter on parkID 519119 lists exactly 75 sites. 56 of them are site-specific reservable gravel 'Primitive Site' pads, all 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 30', 29 of them 'Driveway Entry: Pull-Through' (Sunset Cove Area 2: 20, Veterans Point Area 3: 12, Patriot Lane Area 4: 24); 19 Shady Creek Outback sites are 'Driveway Entry: None', earth surface (walk-in tent, not counted). KDWP's park page lists Shady Creek as its own area (71 primitive). Esri imagery shows an RV-sized vehicle on a Veterans Point pad. So it is a real primitive drive-in campground a 23-ft rig fits, kept with the tent-site caveat (precedent: 2099 Quarry Bay). It is a separate place from 2092 Bluestem Point: the south-shore peninsulas are reached by NE Shady Creek Access Road/Shady Creek Road (OSM), about 1.3 km across open water from Bluestem's loops on the north shore.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery + campitks per-site GIS coordinates (2026-11-06): Sunset Cove Area 2's tip sites 613-615 (about 37.8470,-96.7741) sit outside the loop road, about 13-20 m from the sand beach edge of El Dorado Lake across open grass with scattered trees, with no road or day use between them -> lakefront. Veterans Point 634-637 at the tip of the next peninsula are 15-45 m from the beach but partly screened by tree clumps (lakeview); Patriot Lane 651-681 are behind continuous treelines (not waterfront). Not below the dam: the pads' DEM is 407-412 m against the lake at 407 m, and the dam is about 5 km west.

fees.note: KDWP's statewide schedule from November 1, 2026: a daily camping permit of $17.75 a night per camping unit. Every Shady Creek site is primitive, so no utility fee applies, and none is a designated prime site. A $2.75 processing fee per stay and a vehicle permit ($7 a day) are charged on top. Read 2026-10-15.

fees_source: https://ksoutdoors.gov/licenses-permits-fees/kansas-state-park-entrance-and-camping-fees (as quoted on sibling 2092: 'Beginning November 1, 2026 several Kansas State Park fees will change'; 'Daily Camping Permit ... $12.75 per night $17.75 per night'; 'a $2.75 processing fee will apply to each camping stay'; 'Daily Vehicle Permit ... $5.00 $7.00'), read 2026-10-15 for 2092; fee shape copied from 2092, primitive only: every Shady Creek site is 'Number of Utilities: None' and none is a 'Prime Site' on campitks campsiteDetails, read 2026-11-06

min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

booking.note: Sites are reserved site by site on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov). The reservation window shown on 2026-11-06 ran from Nov 7, 2026 to Dec 6, 2027. Self-registration on arrival is also allowed. 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park.

booking_source: https://www.campitks.gov/camping/eldorado-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=519119 ('2027 CAMPSITES Holiday Minimum Stay Rule: Memorial Day: 3 night minimum'; '14 days maximum consecutive stay rule'; 'Open year round.') and campsiteDetails for sites 611/625/651/682 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Self Reg Allowed: Y', 'Reservation Window: Sat Nov 07 2026 - Mon Dec 06 2027'), read 2026-11-06
flags: hookups: none (electric 0, water false, sewer false) - campitks campsiteDetails, all 75 Shady Creek sites 'Site Type: Primitive Site', 'Number of Utilities: None', read 2026-11-06

booking: reservable site-specific on campitks (ReserveAmerica), self-reg Y, window ~13 months (Nov 7 2026 - Dec 6 2027), max stay 14, 2027 holiday 3-night minimum - campitks campgroundDetails + campsiteDetails, read 2026-11-06

facilities: showers true, flush_toilets true, vault_toilets true - campitks campsiteDetails at every Shady Creek site ('Shower House with Restrooms: Within 1/4 Mile', 'Modern Restrooms: Within 1/4 Mile', 'Vault Toilet: Within 1/4 Mile'), read 2026-11-06. A dump station is listed only by Campendium ('Shady Creek Dump Station'), so it is not stamped.
KDWP's El Dorado page (Wayback capture, as cached by p3-305) says Shady Creek 'Reservable Sites: No', but campitks sells every site site-specific. I went with campitks.

13955 Boulder Bluff's note and inclusion_evidence name 'Sunset Cove Area 2' as a Boulder Bluff loop, but campitks' GIS coordinates put Sunset Cove at Shady Creek (37.8455,-96.7729), 5 km from Boulder Bluff. 13955's note needs fixing.

For the Bemis Creek lead: OSM's 'Shady Creek Road' service way runs east from the Shady Creek peninsulas to about 37.8448,-96.7586, toward Bemis Creek (37.8503,-96.7507). Bemis Creek may be reached from the Shady Creek side rather than through Bluestem Point, so its sibling could be this entry, not 2092.
campitks also lists a loop 'Pelican Point, Area 1' with no sites returned (2026-11-06).
Thin reviews: Campendium has 1 (2019, level spot, 'didn't need to unhook', restrooms dirty with no door); The Dyrt has 1 (2024, site 691 in the Outback, 'tons of sites with nobody else here').
